explanation: How the app learns a Kimi agent finished a turn, now and in the proposed design. Look at where the answer comes from: Kimi's signals today, Kimi's own log afterwards. It leaves out sign-in and the Ready check, which barely change.

before.title: Now: trust Kimi's signals
items: App edits Kimi's settings file to install its 'turn ended' signal
Kimi may rewrite the same file and drop it
Main agent and sub-agents send the same signal
App guesses which one it was, and gets it wrong in edge cases

after.title: Proposed: read Kimi's log
items: App never touches Kimi's settings file
App watches the main agent's own log file
Kimi writes 'turn ended' there for the main agent only, with completed, failed or interrupted
Each turn is counted once, so repeats and late signals do no harm
